title: Evaluation After Appending Two Statements
statement: For any natural number $n$, any list $ss$ of straight-line statements on $n$ Boolean inputs, any two statements $s,t$ on those inputs, and any Boolean input assignment $x$, evaluating $ss$ followed by $s$ and $t$ gives the evaluation of $ss$ followed by the values of $s$ on that evaluation and $t$ on the evaluation extended by the value of $s$.
hypotheses_covered: $ss$ is a list of statements on $n$ inputs
$x$ is a Boolean assignment to the $n$ inputs
